summary: PIMCO Corporate & Income Strategy Fund filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to its principal investment strategies. Effective June 24, 2026, the Fund may now invest in and originate loans; effective July 24, 2026, it may invest without limitation in defaulted bonds. The supplement to its prospectus and statement of additional information is attached. This is a routine strategic policy change, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, or structural event is involved. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are relevant. There is no risk-arb angle.
